description: Somos un equipo de Ingenieros de Sistemas apasionados por el software y la creación de productos de alto impacto. Tenemos habilidades en IA, programación, bases de datos y una buena comunicación en equipo.
summary:
We create a card and decision making game. Each card signifies a decision you will make to carry out the mission. In each round, an event will be activated and your decisions will be key to your survival. 

We solved the challenge by teaching young people to make key decisions for their survival in space intuitively. It is important since interested young people will be able to understand what a space mission is like, how to react, and know how to manage resources when they are scarce.
details:
You enter the game and it gives you a brief explanation of the game and what you will do. Then, when entering a game, it can be with a friend, you receive your cards. In each round each one throws a card (represents a decision) and then globally an event card appears that causes some natural space disaster and each person throws a card that can help mitigate the damage.

This allows young people to make better decisions in difficult situations in space. This project seeks to positively impact the lives of young people who are interested in space and want to understand what could be done in different possible scenarios of an astronaut in space, although those young people who are not so interested can also draw a lot of attention.

We use AI models such as Codex, Meta, GPT and programming agents such as Opencode, Antigravity and Zcode. As for programming languages, mainly TypeScript plus React.

Our project is creative because we mix different mechanics from other games to simulate shortages and give players the need to make decisions and depend on them in different rounds.

We take into account that it is an intuitive game since it has an age range of 7 to 12 years, so an easy-to-understand UI is essential. In addition, we took into account that it has real data and possible cases and shows them in a simpler way so that anyone can understand and react correctly to these.
